name: Sudden Ambush
description: The Doom of Caeranthil dives underwater, then giant bubbles emerge beneath the player for a few seconds. After which, the Doom of Caeranthil then dives up and consumes any player caught in its vicinity, instantly killing them. It will then land in the water nearby, also dealing damage, but not instantly killing them.

name: Pressure Eruption
description: The Doom of Caeranthil dives underwater, then summons multiple geysers underneath players that fling them into the air, potentially knocking them from their boat and dealing significant damage.

name: Tidal Roar
description: The Doom of Caeranthil charges up before releasing a powerful roar that deals damage and stuns players who get too close. In addition, it summons multiple tidal waves that will damage boats and carry away swept enemies.

name: Whirlpool
description: The Doom of Caeranthil swims repetitively in a circle, creating a massive whirlpool that continuously deals massive damage and ragdolls enemies into the air.

name: Luminant Beam
description: The Doom of Caeranthil charges a bright green attack for 15-20 seconds before firing a massive laser that obliterates everything in its path.

name: Barrel Roll
description: The Doom of Caeranthil will spin horizontally, knocking back players who are using their weapons and dealing a low amount of damage. In addition, the Doom of Caeranthil will bite enemies near its head.

name: Pierce
description: When close enough, the Interluminary Parasol starts rapidly stabbing random targets with its arms, sometimes grabbing a player and rapidly draining their blood.

name: Spawn of the Abyss
description: The Interluminary Parasol throws a boulder that deals damage on impact, summoning a Depths mob — either an Alpha Megalodaunt, Broodlord, Thresher, or Nautilodaunt.

name: Enmity's Call
description: The Heart of Enmity raises his axe into the air and summons three Enmity Servants.

name: Condemnation's Fall
description: The Heart of Enmity slightly crouches and hurls his axe, creating an area of effect on impact that deals major damage and ragdolls. This attack is often used on distant players.

name: The Brutalizer
description: The Heart of Enmity stomps the ground to knock down nearby players, then slams his axe down. Can be feinted into Sadist's Fury or Condemnation's Fall.

name: Stomp
description: Elder Primadon will raise his right foot and stomps after a delay.

name: Heavy Stomp
description: Elder Primadon brings his right foot high in the air and roars. After a short while, he stomps the ground, dealing colossal damage to anyone unfortunate enough to be under his feet.

name: Triple Stomp
description: Elder Primadon will raise his left foot, eventually stomping three consecutive times.

name: Stomp Blitz
description: Elder Primadon will raise his left foot, eventually stomping six consecutive times.

name: Punch
description: Elder Primadon punches in front of him.

name: Kick
description: Elder Primadon winds up his right leg before kicking forwards.

name: Grab
description: Elder Primadon grabs in front of him, dealing massive damage after throwing his target.

name: Rock Thorw
description: Elder Primadon bows forward and throws five rocks at his target.

name: Disengage
description: Elder Primadon will jump backwards while throwing two rocks at his target.

name: Ground Slam
description: Elder Primadon bends his knees and lifts his arms up, eventually slamming down after a variable amount of times.

name: Enrage
description: At half health, Elder Primadon becomes enraged, roars and inflicts insanity to anyone affected.

name: Combo
description: Elder Primadon does a stomp, a kick, then a triple stomp in quick succession.

name: Stomp Feint
description: Elder Primadon raises his right foot, but will instead delay it and then proceed to feint. Afterwards he will punch and then he will kick.

name: Triple Stomp Feint
description: Elder Primadon will raise his left foot, eventually stomping once, then feinting the second. Afterwards he will punch.

name: Vehemens Ventus
description: Charges for ~10 seconds then launches a large purple gale orb that deals massive posture and Wind damage on impact; avoid by air-dash, Ghost/Dark Rift, floor drop, waypoint, or portals.

name: Blinding Gale
description: Charges its fist and fires a blinding ball of gale toward the player; animation shared with Pressurized Wind and deals minimal damage.

name: Pressured Wind
description: Charges an arm and releases a purple laser that locks onto a random player and forces a parry; full beam deals heavy damage if not parried.

name: Whiplash
description: Pulls its arm back then swings at the player; the arm remains for ~2 seconds after hitting, leaving the Scion vulnerable to parry follow-ups.

name: Bonestaves of Eld
description: Launches three bones per player in a set order that do medium posture damage; blocked/parried bones fall to the floor to be placed in shrines, hits do low damage and do not drop.

name: Bonegrow
description: Bones appear on the ground and grow upward, launching players into the air with low damage and guaranteeing the next hit; avoid by jumping or rolling through spikes.

name: Bone Stream
description: Bones rise from the ground and circle a floor, remaining active during other attacks, dealing higher damage and unable to be blocked; avoid by jumping or leaving the floor.

name: Debris
description: Summons up to 9 reduced-stat Kyrsgarde Snipers on shrines that cannot move and serve as heal sources when killed.

name: Triple Blood Appendage
description: Shoots three long appendages that latch onto a player/surface before returning. Blocking all three causes heavy posture damage, so parry is recommended.

name: Powerful Blood Appendage
description: Launches one appendage that rapidly targets a player; if it lands, it flings the player toward Chaser. Has an indicator and unparryable sound cue.

name: Burning Blood Explosion
description: Forms a moderately large explosion of blood under the player, then ignites it. Low posture damage but fast cast.

name: Miasma Wave
description: Three waves of blood mist spread out, covering the whole area. Getting hit stuns and prevents jumping, guaranteeing follow-up hits.

name: Stalactite Fall
description: Drops many stalactites from the ceiling. Low posture damage. In phase 2, ceiling collapses and this attack ends permanently.

name: Sanguine Repulsion
description: Uses blood to imitate a vent, launching away all nearby players and ragdolling them. First instance does the most damage.

name: Transfusion
description: Heals ~1250 HP from blood jars. Used after leaving vulnerable state. Cannot be used once all jars are broken.

name: Last Resort
description: Unleashes ~25 localized attacks while chaining all moves in a frenzy. Must stay in the circle below him to avoid.

name: Body Slam
description: In final phase, blood tendrils slam Chaser onto the floor repeatedly, pushing players away from the safe zone. Moderate damage.

name: Blood Frenzy
description: Laughs then uses up to 4 attacks in quick succession. Highlighted in red during use. Only available once jars are gone. Drains 250 HP from Chaser.

name: Dread Breath
description: The Dread Serpent opens its mouth and releases a white-frost beam, dealing extreme rapid damage to those around it and freezing the water. Also deals heavy damage to boats. This attack deals enough damage to knock a MAX POWER player in under two seconds if consistently landed; if hit while knocked, it causes extreme amounts of blood loss. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

name: Claw Swipe
description: Swipes two times in quick succession; each hit will ragdoll you and therefore getting hit by the first swipe will guarantee a hit from the second swipe. Can be rarely preceded by Tail Swipe. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

name: Tail Swipe
description: An attack with the tail, often used after two claw swipes.

name: Strong Left
description: Duke Erisia will charge up a punch and teleport to his target, transitioning to Assault and Critical.

name: Assault
description: Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish.

name: Critical
description: The Duke rushes forwards and unleashes a haymaker punch after Strong Left.

name: Feint
description: Duke Erisia pulls his fist back before it hits you, only to hit you again with his other hand.

name: Shields of Erisia
description: Duke Erisia shields himself in a glowing wind shield reflecting attacks back and ragdolling attackers.

name: Binding Tempest
description: Duke Erisia rises then throws homing balls of air that latch onto those who fail to parry/dodge, then teleports and punches away.

name: Aero Spear
description: Duke Erisia flies into the air and shoots a singular wind lance at his target.

name: Gale Stomp
description: Duke Erisia stomps the ground, conjuring a wave of wind towards his victim.

name: Cyclone Bomb
description: Duke Erisia flies into the air, conjures a huge ball of wind, then throws it down causing massive damage.

name: Mindless Servants
description: Duke Erisia snaps his fingers, summoning Mindless Servants from pods.

name: Vent
description: An explosion of blue ether around the user that pushes opponents away.

name: Lightning Clones
description: Summons four clones that run and slash at players.

name: Lightning Strike
description: Rains multiple thunderbolts from the sky.

name: Lightning Assault
description: Teleports to the player for a rapid three-hit lightning dash.

name: Grand Volley
description: Fires four slow purple javelins with high posture damage.

name: Displacement
description: Teleports to pre-determined spots to un-stun and reset.

name: Mortal Draw: Maestro's Flourish
description: Performs vertical and horizontal slashes followed by delayed aftercuts.

name: Mortal Draw: Floating Passage
description: A flurry of slashes where he remains vulnerable afterward.

name: Mortal Draw: Dharma Descent
description: A leaping or downward strike that includes an autogrip finisher.

name: Mortal Draw: Mangetsu
description: Draws back before unleashing a vortex of gale-speed slashes.

name: Mortal Draw: Pressure
description: Flash steps to perform a circular slash similar to Ankle Cutter.

name: Tempest Eye
description: A high-speed gale attack described as faster than kunai.

name: Maestro's Kick
description: A flourish kick used to finish a katana swing combo.

name: Talon Swipe
description: Swipes with one arm; speed varies by arm used.

name: Strong Swipe
description: Delayed left-hand swipe using Red Telegraph.

name: Shade Cloak
description: Unleashes a shadowy burst that drains sanity.

name: Curb Stomp
description: Stomps ground after lifting leg; Cyan/Green telegraph.

name: Feather Coat
description: Aura of black feathers providing a chip damage buff.

name: Owl Dash
description: Spinning assault with shadowy waves after kneeling.

name: Overhead Grab
description: Jumps and descends as feathers to grab the player.

name: Flock of Feathers
description: Bursts into feathers to target and chip block damage.

name: Trample
description: Primadon performs 3 quick stomps with its left foot.

name: Kick Blunt
description: Primadon winds back its right leg to deliver a devastating kick.

name: Rock Throw
description: Primadon swipes the earth using his right arm, hurling 3 rocks.

name: Disengage (Fade Away)
description: Primadon jumps backward while throwing 1 rock at the player.

name: The Legion's Martial Arts
description: Titus firmly swings his fists at his opponent with hyperarmor.

name: Imperator's Fury
description: Quickly slams down both arms into the ground, knocking players away with a vent.

name: Worldpiercing Deluge
description: Smashes arms into the ground causing three consecutive shockwaves.

name: Worldshattering Smackdown
description: Grabs the opponent before smacking them into the ground.

name: Commander's Rage
description: Unleashes an echoing roar that temporarily amplifies his attacks.

name: Commander's Whirlthrow
description: Grabs the opponent, spins around, and sends them flying.

name: Splitting Ascension
description: Ascends into the air and crashes into the ground, knocking down opponents.

name: Sovereign Drive
description: Dashes forward in a blink, knocking down enemies in its path.

name: Skycrash
description: Leaps towards the opponent, stomping and knocking them away.

name: Wrathful Stomp
description: Slowly winds up before releasing a stomp that sends opponents into the air.

name: Warp Kick
description: Warps to a random opponent and kicks them away.

name: Blighted Sparks
description: Summons three orbs of white lightning that lock onto the nearest opponent.

name: Chorus Divide: Shattering Crescendo
description: Channels high-pressure beams of wind in a 360 degree motion.

name: Flame Grab
description: Aska lunges forward for a grab that slams the player and sets them on fire.

name: Flame Sentinel
description: Aska creates an orb that will shoot fireballs at the player.

name: Flaming Scourge
description: Aska gathers flames and spins a whip to grab and slam the player.

name: Ash Slam
description: Aska imbues their fist with flames that strike twice and create explosions.

name: Relentless Flames
description: Aska releases a flurry of seven slashes.

name: Flare Volley
description: Aska fires a blast of flames at the player.

name: Slash
description: Swings its sword at the opponent once or twice.

name: Wind Cutter
description: Slashes at the air with its sword, creating a crescent-shaped projectile.

name: Terra Eruption
description: Punches the ground, causing a pillar to erupt below the player.

name: Crushing Grab
description: Holds right arm high before swinging forward to grab and crush the target.

name: Charge
description: Readies a stance before charging forward, ragdolling and knocking back those hit.

name: Spin Thrust
description: Winds up right arm and thrusts forward with spinning hand, hitting three times.

name: Leap
description: Leaps a small distance towards the target, crushing with impact damage.

name: Bone Spikes
description: Raises leg and stomps to emit a long carpet of rising bone spikes.

name: Femur Throw
description: Digs into ground to pull out a large femur and throws it at high speeds.

name: Warden's Blades
description: Summons four spinning blades of ice around himself that deal constant damage.

name: Blood Stakes
description: Creates spikes out of his own blood to impale enemies, draining blood on hit.

name: Rising Frost
description: Summons an ice glaive and performs a barrage that lifts both into the air.

name: Ice Flock
description: Summons a flock of rapid moving ice birds to attack from all angles.

name: Deep Webbing
description: The Widow spits webs, inflicting moderate insanity and dragging the target towards herself.

name: Venomous Bite
description: The Widow delivers a crushing bite with lingering poison; auto-grips if health is low.

name: Swipe
description: The Widow slashes using her right leg with a long charge, dealing moderate slashing damage.

name: Impale
description: The Widow quickly lunges with both of her legs, dealing moderate damage.

name: Articulated Thrash
description: The Widow charges up her leg and slashes the target three times in succession.

name: High Swing
description: The Enforcer lifts its weapon high and swings it down; slower with high damage.

name: Low Swing
description: The Enforcer swings its weapon horizontally; faster but deals less damage.

name: Whirlwind
description: Begins to spin rapidly from the waist-up while walking toward the opponent.

name: Space Pull
description: Holds its hand out and pulls the nearest person to it, leaving them hanging.

name: Thousand Needles
description: Spews a constant spray of coral shards; parrying once defends the entire attack.

name: Roar
description: Inflicts Insanity and Fear and increases posture damage taken by nearby targets.

name: Cero
description: Fires a massive dark laser beam that vaporizes and auto-grips low health targets.

name: Jump
description: A mobility move used to close the distance to targets located above the monster.

name: Normal Critical
description: Flips the Boltcrusher backwards for a slam followed by a twirling strike.

name: Running Critical
description: A short dash forward followed by a devastating lightning-charged slam.

name: Grand Javelin
description: Conjures a lance of Thundercall and throws it towards the player.

name: Iron Tether
description: Conjures cubes of Ironsing and tethers them together with Thundercall.

name: Metal Ball
description: Wraps self in a spiked metal ball and rapidly rolls towards the player.

name: Emotion Wave
description: Slams a lightning bolt into the ground to send out an omnidirectional wave.

name: Execute
description: Pins down the opponent and bashes their face in with the weapon.

name: Lightning Stream
description: Casts a stream of lightning that pulls the opponent towards them.

name: Thunder Kick
description: Raises a leg and kicks the opponent with thunder.

name: Storm Blades
description: Conjures five blades of thunder in front of the user.

name: Restrain
description: A powerful kick that chains the opponent to the user, even if blocked.

name: Rupture
description: Detonates a chained opponent, dealing high damage and ragdolling them.

name: Flip-Kick
description: Flips into the air to strike; used to close gaps or reach higher targets.

name: Drop-Kick
description: A sprinting drop kick that sends the target flying on impact.

name: Electro Stomp
description: Stomps to create geysers in a line; unparryable and insta-grips on hit.

name: Mudskipperification
description: A finishing punch that turns the incapacitated player into a Mudskipper.

name: Wind Blade
description: Launches a slash of compressed wind towards the opponent.

name: Wind Forge
description: Conjures several blades of wind that impale the target.

name: Gale Punch
description: Releases a punch of wind that knocks the opponent back.

name: Wind Carve
description: Creates a swirl of sharp winds that carve opponents within the area.

name: Wind Passage
description: Rushes forward instantly, leaving aftercuts of wind along the path.

name: Ice Daggers
description: Lodestar forms 3 daggers of ice before throwing them towards the nearest target.

name: Crystal Impale
description: Lodestar ascends before performing a quick spinning dash towards the target.

name: Sightless Beam
description: Lodestar fires a high pressure beam from their blindfolded eyes.

name: Rising Shadow
description: User moves their hands outward, creating a black tendril that chases nearby enemies.

name: Revenge
description: A quick dash signified by a red-line effect, the mantra teleports him forward upon hitting the player or the player's block.

name: Shadow Assault
description: Windup before turning into shadows and dashing forward, dealing very minor damage to anyone in your way while applying darkness.

name: Eclipse Kick
description: The user performs a slow axe kick, causing nearby opponents to be ragdolled and flung back.

name: Shadow Eruption
description: The user swipes with their right hand before releasing a large sphere of shadow.

name: Right Hook
description: The Broodlord throws a brutal and powerful punch.

name: Left Hook
description: The Broodlord throws another brutal and heavy blow. Typically used right after Punch.

name: Broodrot Thrust
description: Delivers a stronger, unparriable thrust with its rotten fist.

name: Broodrot Smash
description: Rigorously leaps forward and raises its arms into the air, swinging down on its prey with an unparriable rotten slam.

name: Call of the Horde
description: Unleashes a blood-curdling screech that alerts any nearby mobs of your presence.

name: Flip-Kick Blunt
description: Nautilodaunt flips into the air and attempts to strike their prey with a kick.

name: Drop-Kick Blunt
description: Nautilodaunt initiates a full sprint before committing to a drop kick on its prey.

name: Grand Stomp
description: Nautilodaunt stomps the ground, sending rubble powered by geysers hurtling towards you in a straight line.

name: Tacet Hug
description: The Prime Megalodaunt turns invisible, grabs the target, chews it down, and throws it away.

name: Tacet Drop Kick
description: Starts out similarly to Tacet Hug, but after it turns visible again, it will throw out its entire body in a drop kick.

name: Energy Wave
description: Slashes at the air with its sword, creating a crescent-shaped projectile aimed at the opponent.

name: Maledicta Terra
description: Punches the ground, causing a pillar to erupt below the player.

name: Moonscorched Blades
description: Causes a rain of white flaming javelins from the sky.

name: Fire Blade (Starkindred)
description: While he has his wings out, Iblis will rise in the air before unleashing a big wave of flames in front of him.

name: Flame Ballista
description: Conjures a flaming arrow and fires it at the nearest target.

name: Ascension
description: Rises into the air, before swooping in downwards.

name: Sinister Halo
description: Launches a multi hit halo of divine energy forward.

name: Celestial Assault
description: Delivers an upward slash that makes both parties airborne before delivering another sideway slash.

name: Ice Eruption
description: Stomps the ground, creating a wave of ice in front of him, trapping anyone hit in ice.

name: Gale Lunge
description: Lunges forward with their weapon out, dealing damage and inflicting Winded/Suffocate.

name: Heavenly Wind
description: Rises into the air, before abruptly slamming back down onto the ground.

name: Rising Wind
description: Delivers a uppercut, if it connects, both parties are raised into the air.

name: Glare
description: Eyes light up to stun anyone facing them; can be parried or blocked.

name: Gaze
description: Swirling symbol in eyes causes insanity shivers; unparryable.

name: Exhaustion Strike
description: A medium-ranged jab that transfers the user's posture damage to the target.

name: Dash
description: A long-distance dash used purely for mobility.

name: Light Piercer
description: Fires 5 spears of light from the air that slow targets; has autoparry frames.

name: Ice Fissure
description: Summons an ice obelisk on top of the opponent.

name: Ice Cubes
description: Conjures 3 ice cubes that are thrown towards the opponent.

name: Ice Smash
description: Summons a huge ice club and hits the ground, guardbreaking on hit.

name: Jolt Grab
description: Magnet Spark grab attack.

name: Rapid Punches
description: Unleashes a barrage of blows against foes.

name: Weapon Swing
description: A basic slash or strike with their equipped weapon.

name: Dagger Slash
description: A quick slash with a dagger.

name: Dagger Critical
description: A charged thrust with a dagger.

name: Fire Blade
description: User slams down with their blade coated in flames.

name: Flame Repulsion
description: After a wind-up of ~2 seconds, user releases a burning AoE blast.

name: Fire Palm
description: Conjures a wave of fire from the palm of the users hand.

name: Fire Eruption
description: An eruption of flame under the user hitting anyone nearby.

name: Ice Spikes
description: Conjure a spike of ice from the ground at cursor location.

name: Ice Blade
description: Creates two blades of ice and rushes forward rapidly slashing.

name: Lightning Impact
description: Rises into the air slamming back down with lightning empowered kick.

name: Air Force
description: A burst of air directly in front of the user.

name: Onslaught
description: Reels back and swing their weapon, unleashing an onslaught of blows if it hits.

name: Taunt
description: Yells out a taunt applying an effect to the opponent.

name: Astral Wind
description: User preforms a teleporting slash in the shape of star before returning to their original position.

name: Champion's Whirlthrow
description: User grabs their target before spinning them in 360 degrees and then tossing them.

name: Clutching Shadow
description: Targets one enemy within a radius around the caster (signified by a red glow around the targeted foe) and lifts them up into the air before slamming them down.

name: Chain Pull
description: Summons a chain out of their hand that quickly pulls you towards them.

name: Flame Assault
description: User dashes forward covered in flames; hitting anyone in their path.

name: Rising Flame
description: User spins and releases a fury of flames that sends both the user and opponent vertically into the air.

name: Scratch
description: Weakly smacks opponent over and over again until knocked. Has relatively high hitstun.

name: Prominence Draw
description: The Lost Diver locks onto all the closest target that is in their range, then dashes forward and performs a large AoE slice.

name: Pressure Blast
description: A heavy downwards swing that cleaves through the air, sending out 3 large blasts of air that ragdoll and knockback.

name: Variable Moveset
description: Dependent on Oath, weapon, and Mantras. Variants include Songseeker, Black Diver, etc.

name: Time-Slowing Orb
description: The Semblance creates a bubble. Any player or non-allied npc that steps inside is severely slowed.

name: Twister Kicks
description: The Semblance dashes forwards kicking with a rush of winds dealing damage.

name: Hollow Embrace
description: Lunges forwards and grabs the target, draining sanity.

name: Shadow Gun
description: Fires a projectile of shadow ether at the target.

name: Shadow Roar
description: Releases a burst of shadow energy around the user.

name: Shadow Meteor
description: Summons meteors of shadow to strike the area.

name: Shadow Seekers
description: Fires homing shadow projectiles.

name: Summon Minions
description: Summons undead allies to fight for them.

name: Shadow Chains
description: Binds the target with shadow chains.

name: Needle Barrage
description: User leaps into the air and pelts the enemy with a trio of metal rods.

name: Firing Line
description: User forms five rifles out of metal that open fire on their target.

name: Oxidizing Rush
description: User rushes forward while surrounded by an array of metal swords.

name: Metal Eruption
description: Stomps on the ground, spawning a flurry of metal spikes.

name: Rocket Lance
description: Forms a lance to impale the target, sending them flying.

name: Flashdraw Strike
description: User sheathes their sword before following up with a teleporting uppercut.

name: Wind Gun
description: A powerful wind blast that applies Suffocation on hit.

name: Rapid Slashes
description: Swiftly rushes into the enemy and cuts them apart.

name: Adrenaline Surge
description: An adrenaline rush of mobility. Grants a speed boost to the caster.

name: Burning Servants
description: Summon a legion of flaming spearmen that lunge inwards.

name: Lightning Blade
description: Arcing blades of electricity.

name: Glacial Shower
description: Rains down shards of ice from above.

name: Iceberg
description: Freezes self to mend wounds; has autoparry frames if hit.

name: Flame Blind
description: Shoots a projectile that explodes and blinds anyone looking at it.

name: Master's Flourish
description: Caster sends powerful slash that chips through block and slashes through armor.

name: Glacial Arc
description: Fires an arc of ice toward the target.

name: Jolt Grab (Magnet Spark)
description: Teleports to the nearest target before releasing a shocking electric AoE.

name: Encircle
description: Conjures shadows around the enemy before warping to them after a short delay.

name: Spark Swap
description: Snaps fingers to swap positions with the target.

name: Jolt Grab (Unstable Capacitor)
description: Dashes forward to grab and smash the opponent into the floor.

name: Rising Thunder
description: Rushes forward to grab the opponent and crash down as a bolt of lightning.

name: Blinding Dawn
description: Spins rapidly while unleashing powerful rays of light.

name: Radiant Kick
description: Teleports to the opponent with a high-speed kick.

name: Radiant Dawn
description: Leaps into the air and crashes down with light; unparryable and unblockable.

name: Ice Chain
description: User forms chains of ice that latch onto opponents.

name: Bolt Piercer
description: Fires a lightning arrow into the sky to rain thunder on the target.

name: Electro Carve
description: Creates a potent electromagnetic field that shocks nearby targets.

name: Ground Critical
description: Enters a stance before rushing forward, unleashing a fiery whirlwind on enemy contact.

name: Aerial Critical
description: While in the air, performs a fiery downwards sweep, applying Knockdown and Burn.

name: Arc Wave
description: Performs a quick stomp on the ground that releases a wave of energy, dealing fire and lightning damage.

name: Arc Beam
description: Shoots out a laser from the user's eyes that explodes after a second, dealing fire and lightning damage.

name: Mecha Gatling
description: The user pulls out a Gatling gun, mowing down enemies caught in the line of fire.

name: Explosion (Passive)
description: Violently explodes after being gripped/killed, dealing AoE Autogrip damage.

name: Pickaxe Swipe
description: Weakly slashes opponent with a pickaxe over and over again until knocked.

name: Lumbering Thrust
description: Delivers a stronger, unparriable thrust with its fist that ragdolls.

name: Bite
description: Leans forward to bite down and ragdoll those hit. Only used while in water.

name: Pyroclastic Roar
description: An orange-ringed roar that summons flaming swords raining down; does not apply debuffs.

name: Blazing Kick
description: A charged kick that sets hit targets on fire and causes heavy stagger.

name: Bullet Fury
description: Shoulder-mounted cannon rapidly fires short-range bursts at the target.

name: Furnace Explosion
description: Marks a glowing area then creates a delayed fiery explosion; causes ragdoll.

name: Heavy Punch
description: The Stonespark winds up its right arm and throws a heavier punch at its target.

name: Two-Hand Slam
description: The Golem slams both fists down in front of it.

name: Spin
description: The Golem spins its torso rapidly, hitting multiple times.

name: Laser
description: Charges a white orb at its core before firing a beam that causes an explosion.

name: Scream
description: The Golem roars, causing rocks to fall from the ceiling.

name: Uppercut
description: A swift upward strike that can ragdoll players.

name: Recessive Spin
description: Spins arms rapidly, dealing damage at high speed with autoparry frames.

name: Prime Laser
description: Charges and fires a red laser, dealing massive damage in a small AoE.

name: Laser Barrage
description: Fires a barrage of red lasers, dealing high damage rapidly.

name: Whirling Blade
description: Spins rapidly with its blades, dealing damage in an area.

name: Spin Attack
description: Rotates its body rapidly, hitting enemies around it.

name: Wind Orb
description: Fires a projectile of wind ether at the target.

name: Lifeweave Orb
description: Fires a projectile of lifeweave ether at the target.

name: Bite Combo
description: Bites three times in quick succession.

name: No Trace Left Behind
description: A disengaging maneuver that may deal damage.

name: Ice Beam
description: Fires a powerful beam of frost energy.

name: Arm Swipe
description: Stands on hind legs and swipes twice.

name: Burrow
description: Digs underground and resurfaces to attack.

name: Royal Breath
description: Exhales a powerful breath attack.

name: Pillar
description: Summons a stone pillar from the ground.

name: Wind Slash
description: A ranged wind projectile.

name: Claw Smash
description: A heavy slam with the giant claw.

name: Crab Summon
description: Spawns smaller crabs to attack.

name: Leech
description: Latches onto the player, consuming blood.

name: Electric Stun Pulse
description: Releases an electric shockwave.

name: Static Discharge
description: A massive release of static electricity.

name: Greater Stun Pulse
description: A larger version of the stun pulse.

name: Spawn Gigameds
description: Summons smaller Gigameds.

name: Right Arm Swipe
description: A quick swipe with the right arm.

name: Left Arm Swipe
description: A delayed swing with the left arm.

name: Double Swipe
description: Two rapid claw swipes.

name: Pounce
description: Leaps towards the player.

name: Ram
description: Charges at the player.

name: Clenching Assault
description: Swings once then grabs and drills the player.

name: Slam
description: Crushes hands onto the ground.

name: Cloaking Assault
description: Goes invisible then reappears with a 2-hit combo.

name: Spear Thrust
description: A forward thrust with the ice spear.

name: Spear Sweep
description: A sweeping attack with the spear.

name: Glacial Javelin
description: Throws a conjured ice spear.

name: Skyward Spear
description: Backflips and throws a spear from the air.

name: Permafrost Colosseum
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion summons a large ring of ice pillars, simmilar to Ice Eruption's round spark variant. This move is only used when you deal damage to it.

name: Pylons of Frost
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion spins its glaive in the air before slamming into the ground, causing three pillars of ice to erupt in succesion from beneath the player.

name: Decapitating Sweep
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion performs two low slashes with its glaive, before spinning into a high slash. the third slash is marked by a yellow indicator, crouch to avoid this attack.

name: Altitude Swipes
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion performs a quick jumpable sweep, followed by another that must be crouched.

name: Frostgrave
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion proceeds to raise its glaive, before detonating ice below the player's feet.

name: Champion's Quake
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion crouches slightly before jumping up and crashing into the ground. This attack deals damage as soon as The Champion's feet touch the ground.

name: Rime-Rise
description: With a horizontal slash, the Kyrsgarde Champion creates a line of ice spikes in the direction of the nearest target. This attack is capable of dealing very high damage due to each "ice spike" The Champion sends dealing one instance of damage.

name: Splintered Thrust
description: The Champion lets out a swift thrust with its glaive.

name: Crossrend Cryocleave
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion uses its glaive to execute two slashes, followed by a sweep that must be jumped over, and an overhead slash that must be avoided by dodging.

name: Shatterline
description: Enraged, the Champion raises its glaive and summons two ice spikes, rushing forth and delivering two slices.

name: Blizzard's Sanction
description: The Kyrsgarde Champion briefly winds up before unleashing four cleaves, followed by a delayed Splintered Thrust. All four slashes follow the green telegraph.

name: High Cleave
description: Simple upward slash toward the right.

name: Crush & Rend
description: Kick obscured by dust, followed by a downward swing.

name: Graceful Slicer
description: Leaps backward and slashes twice in opposing directions.

name: Severing Flourish
description: Spinning red-highlighted double slash.

name: Low Cleave
description: Simple slash with a blue highlight (Crouch/Uppercut).

name: Shogun's Brutality
description: Stomp followed by two fast slashes and a leg sweep.

name: Serpent-Slaying Sweep
description: Crouching left slash, red slash, then two spinning slashes.

name: Mortal Draw: Sakura Dance
description: Roar followed by a flurry of rapid mixed slashes.

name: Tendril Cage
description: Summons white circles that erupt into tendrils.

name: Tendril Uprising
description: Tendrils erupt from the ground beneath the target.

name: Brushstrokes of Black
description: Black strings manifest on the ground.

name: Tendril Cascade
description: Red-highlighted tendril attack.

name: Pillars of Black
description: Rains down pillars from the sky.

name: Prophet's Drop Punch
description: Dashing kicks followed by a punch.

name: Prophet's Aerial Assault
description: Flies up and performs a green-highlighted punch.

name: Prophet's Divebomb
description: Divebombs the target from the air.

name: Equalizer Punch
description: Teleports, latches with strings, punches away then pulls back.

name: Heel Slice
description: Teleports and performs a spinning heel slice.

name: The Master Of The House
description: Creates a singularity pulling targets in.

name: Flip Kick
description: Acrobatic flip kick.

name: High Flip Kick
description: Higher variation of the flip kick.

name: Furious Stomp
description: Rapid stomp attack.

name: Combo Slam
description: Multi-hit slam combo.

name: Homerun Bat
description: The Heart of Enmity kneels down and grabs a nearby player, tosses them up then bats them with his axe.

name: Sadistic Fury
description: The Heart of Enmity kneels down and performs a fast double-swing with its axe, dealing high damage.

name: Event Horizon
description: The Heart of Enmity raises its arm and charges a pull attack, forcing players to go within the attack's blind spot near Enmity. Anybody caught outside the blind spot will be pulled and take serious damage.

name: Spread; Obsidian Wings
description: The Heart of Enmity quickly leaps up with his wings before striking the player with his axe.

name: Everlasting Agony
description: The Heart of Enmity, filled with contempt, makes an unparryable charge towards the player, sending them upwards before slowly taking flight and crashing down at them, dealing major damage.

name: Reposition
description: The Heart of Enmity quickly darts from one side to another, often following up with an attack.

name: Sadistic Edge
description: The Heart of Enmity performs a quick slash.

name: Ferocious Barrage
description: Knell slashes at the player with his claws six times.

name: Arachnid Leap
description: Knell jumps into the air and slams into the ground. Can be avoided by jumping.

name: Pouncing Grapple
description: Knell lunges towards the player grabbing them before bitting them twice. Drains a high amount of sanity.

name: Bell Fall
description: Knell flicks one of his hands upwards, causing a small cluster of bells to fall on top of the player.

name: Great Bell Fall
description: Knell throws both of his hands forwards, causing a large cluster of bells to fall on top of the player. Applies knockdown on hit.

name: Raining Resonation
description: Knell lets out a scream, making bells continuously rain on the player. Deals low posture damage.

name: A Toll of the Bell
description: Knell spins around holding a massive bell before hurling it at the player. Deals extremely high damage. It is recommended to full roll instead of roll canceling. Knell only uses this attack during his second phase.

name: Carillon Call
description: Knell lets out a scream, causing bells to rain in a circle around him. Knell only uses this attack during his second phase.

name: Rain Chimes
description: Knell twirls in place and summon chimes that rain from above. Knell only uses this attack in the second phase.
